chatgpt.welcomeDescription: Atd will use your ChatGPT plan for this connection. Manage usage and access in ChatGPT settings.
chatgpt.usageLimit: This ChatGPT plan or Atd’s app allowance has reached a limit. Requests are paused. Review your usage, then resume requests in connection settings, or choose another provider.
chatgpt.usageUnavailable: ChatGPT usage information is temporarily unavailable. Your sign-in is preserved. Try again later.
chatgpt.privacyIdentity: Atd receives your account ID and email to identify this connection. Authorization tokens stay in your macOS keychain; account details and consent settings are stored locally. Atd does not send these credentials to an Atd server.
chatgpt.privacyContent: For model requests, Atd sends OpenAI your prompt, conversation context, and any attachments or tool results included in the task. OpenAI processes this data under its privacy policy. Background memory reviews also send relevant conversation content when you allow background use.
chatgpt.privacyControl: Local task history and memory follow your Atd settings. Disconnecting removes this connection’s local tokens and requests revocation; existing task history and memory remain until you delete them. You can also revoke access in ChatGPT settings. There is no Atd fee to connect or use this integration.
chatgpt.privacyAccept: I understand and agree to connect.
chatgpt.backgroundDescription: Allow scheduled tasks, automatic memory reviews and consolidation, and apps’ AI requests to use this connection’s ChatGPT allowance, including while you are away. Off by default. Save changes to apply or withdraw this permission; requests already sent may finish.
chatgpt.backgroundRequired: Background use is off for this connection. Enable it in Settings → Providers, or choose a different connection for this background task.
chatgpt.privacyRequired: Review and accept the ChatGPT privacy notice in Settings → Providers before using this connection.
chatgpt.planDisabled: Signed in · plan usage not enabled
chatgpt.planDisabledDescription: Your ChatGPT account is signed in, but plan usage is not enabled. Enable it for Atd, or add a separate API key connection.
chatgpt.connectedDescription: Choose a default model to get started. Your background-use preference is saved separately in this connection’s settings.
chatgpt.notEligible: This ChatGPT account is not eligible to share its plan with Atd. Use an API key or another provider; signing in again won’t change eligibility.
chatgpt.userUnavailable: ChatGPT cannot serve this account right now. Your sign-in is preserved. Try again later.
chatgpt.unsupportedCapability: ChatGPT plan sharing does not support this request’s capability. Change the request or use an API key connection.
chatgpt.unsupportedRoute: This endpoint is not supported for ChatGPT plan sharing. Use a supported request or an API key connection.
chatgpt.invalidUser: ChatGPT could not validate this account. Sign in again from connection settings.
chatgpt.authorizationInvalid: ChatGPT rejected this authorization context. Review access and sign in again from connection settings.
chatgpt.privacySummary: Atd receives your account details and sends task content to OpenAI. Sign-in credentials stay on this Mac.
chatgpt.backgroundSummary: Let automations, memory reviews, and apps use your plan while you’re away.
chatgpt.backgroundBeforeConsent: Agree to connect first, then allow automations, memory reviews, and apps to use your plan while you’re away.
